rules.rule: If vanilla behavior matters, keep the functional vanilla block and microblock adjacent trim instead.
Every cell material must be validated against the active provider material library before compile/export.
Use the fewest cell materials needed to preserve the vanilla palette story; microblocks are shape tools first.
Preserve directional material states such as log/pillar axes through transforms where the provider supports them.
Keep glass, fluids, animated/tinted and unsupported functional materials vanilla unless provider capability explicitly changes.
A microblock host may preserve appearance/material cells but must not be assumed to preserve the source block functional behavior.
